minimalCompletenessFindings: Qualitative-only and formula-only work each score 3 and fail. Missing all momentum-change evidence scores 7; missing the interval calculation scores 6; magnitude-only work scores 7. Exact numerical expressions can establish complete performance without separate intermediate lines. Nevertheless, generic momentum-change evidence plus a final force passes at 8.5, and omission of physical-direction interpretation passes at exactly 8. Adding the 0.5 unit omission to the latter gives 7.5 and fails. Explicit false instantaneous/constant assertions each still pass at 8.5; merely omitting optional discussion incurs no deduction. The isolated arithmetic slip scores 9.5 with no follow-on losses.
